svg.title: The local projection cutting contradiction
svg.desc: A schematic of the exact corner maps theta and conjugation by u, followed by the estimates that contradict a positive overlap infimum. The diagram states no finite dimensional assumption.

g.text: A positive overlap bound forces an outer corner map
Let θ be properly outer; assume b = inf ‖fθ(f)‖ > 0 over nonzero f ≤ p.
Both polar endpoints: u*u = θ(e), uu* = e.
eθ(e) = ku, with b e ≤ k and ‖k − b e‖ < d.
If ρ were inner, its implementer would extend to the central support of e.
The global outer test in eMe gives 0 ≠ f ≤ e with ‖fρ(f)‖ < d.
This contradicts the definition of b. Therefore the infimum is zero.
Exact maps and endpoint identities: LPC.16–LPC.18. Inner-corner extension: LPC.1–LPC.4.
The boxes represent von Neumann algebra corners of arbitrary dimension.
